chunks: Indeed, they will come to know soon;

key_terms.سَيَعْلَمُونَ: They will know (future tense, third person plural)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'They will come to know' signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine reckoning, emphasizing that the denial of the Hereafter is a temporary state of ignorance before the ultimate revelation of truth. It serves as a warning to the disbelievers of Mecca, assuring them that their hidden deeds will be fully exposed and judged by Allah, reinforcing the concept of 'Adl' (Divine Justice). The emphatic particle 'Kalla' (No/Indeed) highlights the certainty of this future knowledge, contrasting their current arrogance with the impending reality.
